description: Every aircraft whose latest reported position lies inside a box (edges included) and is at most 180 seconds old (live), each as get_aircraft_position reports it, nearest the box's centre first (ties by icao24, so a limit always keeps the same ones). An aircraft whose latest position is older, or lies outside the box, is not listed. total counts them all; truncated is true when the limit cut the farthest from the centre. Sides are at most 10 degrees of latitude and of longitude; latitudes beyond 85.05112878 degrees north or south are outside the area index, so a box may not reach past them and an aircraft there is never listed. Positions are what the aircraft's own transponder broadcast, picked up by ground receivers and relayed to GADUIN with a delay, so reported_at_utc, not the time of the request, is when the aircraft was there; where no receiver hears the aircraft (over oceans and remote land) there is no position for that stretch.

bbox.description: The box as minLon,minLat,maxLon,maxLat in decimal degrees, e.g. -0.6,51.3,0.3,51.7: longitudes from -180 to 180, latitudes from -85.05112878 to 85.05112878, minLat below maxLat, each side at most 10 degrees; minLon greater than maxLon crosses the 180th meridian.

limit.description: Max aircraft to return, nearest the centre first (1-500). Defaults to 100.

name: list_aircraft_in_area
title: Aircraft in an area
